query: WITH checks AS (SELECT 'source_pages'::text AS metric, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 UNION ALL SELECT 'facts', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 UNION ALL SELECT 'notes', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 UNION ALL SELECT 'mcqs', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page IN (480, 481, 483) UNION ALL SELECT 'mcq_options', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id = o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page IN (480, 481, 483) UNION ALL SELECT 'flashcards', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0479-0483:%' UNION ALL SELECT 'search_documents', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.search_documents d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_facts f WHERE d.entity_type = 'fact' AND d.entity_id = f.id AND f.source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_notes n WHERE d.entity_type = 'note' AND d.entity_id = n.id AND n.source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gk_mcqs m WHERE d.entity_type = 'mcq' AND d.entity_id = m.id AND m.source_page IN (480, 481, 483)) UNION ALL SELECT 'tag_assignments', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.content_tag_assignments WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_verifications', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 UNION ALL SELECT 'verified_claims', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 AND verification_status = 'verified' UNION ALL SELECT 'source_attributed_claims', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 479 AND 483 AND verification_status = 'source_attributed' UNION ALL SELECT 'low_confidence_mcqs', COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page IN (480, 481, 483) AND confidence = 'low') SELECT metric, value FROM checks ORDER BY metric;
